comments.body: Should email digests honor quiet hours too, or only push? Parking email out of scope for v1.

content.text: Should email digests honor quiet hours too, or only push? Parking email out of scope for v1.
Push alerts fire at all hours. Users want a quiet window for desktop and mobile independently so overnight pings stop without disabling notifications entirely.

Under notification preferences, add Quiet hours with start/end times, timezone (default profile TZ), and channel toggles for desktop push vs mobile push. During the window, pushes are held and delivered as a single summary at window end unless the event is marked critical (security alerts).
Criteria: server-side enforcement so background workers do not bypass the client, preview of next quiet window on the settings page, and an escape hatch “Allow critical” defaulting to on.
